name: kitsuvo
description: Less AI, less Slop. Browse with Kitsuvo, inspect AI-built evidence, and check responsive layouts. Requires the Kitsuvo desktop browser.

interface.longDescription: Connect your installed Kitsuvo browser to browse pages, inspect detection evidence and check responsive layouts. Local automation uses an isolated profile. Cloud clients use the opt-in authenticated relay or a workspace Secure MCP Tunnel. The plugin does not install the browser.
defaultPrompt: Open this site in Kitsuvo and explain its detection evidence.
Check this page at phone and desktop sizes.
